The implementation schedule covers August 24 to December 4, 2026 (Weeks 1–15) and reflects the work done so far. It is followed by the Weekly Task Plan, which assigns an owner to every task of Weeks 6 to 15.

## Timeline

The schedule is dated, runs from August 24 to December 4, 2026, and marks the five key dates: October 11 (Checkpoint 1), October 25 (Checkpoint 2), November 13 (report draft), November 20 (final report), and December 4 (presentation). The external conveyor interfaces were removed from the project scope, and the software, electrical, mechanical-design, and documentation work that runs alongside the construction is shown as its own group. The first letter of each label is the person leading the task, and the second, if any, is the person helping.

## Weekly Task Plan

Each task has an owner, who leads it, and, where applicable, a second person who helps. The plan is updated every Sunday: each task of the past week is marked Done, Partial, or Slipped, the actual work is recorded, and slipped tasks are moved to a later week with a note. The original rows are never deleted. A dash in the Status column means the week's outcome has not been recorded yet.
